<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, touching **70** documentable anchor(s).

**69** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5c005e0e42e207b073843b255248877b84442342`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `recordId (4 routes)`
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `organization_id (symbol, 40 pages)`, `PERMISSION_DENIED (literal, 52 pages)`
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **41** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5c005e0e42e207b073843b255248877b84442342` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5a41ed07ab4ad2211d114132a2f680545a1d0f26` — the merge of head `2aaea77af4ce68f15c26c1643eeb3330f9629d99` into base `5c005e0e42e207b073843b255248877b84442342`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5a41ed07ab4ad2211d114132a2f680545a1d0f26 && git checkout 5a41ed07ab4ad2211d114132a2f680545a1d0f26
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5c005e0e42e207b073843b255248877b84442342 2aaea77af4ce68f15c26c1643eeb3330f9629d99 && git checkout -B drift-repro 5c005e0e42e207b073843b255248877b84442342 && git merge --no-ff 2aaea77af4ce68f15c26c1643eeb3330f9629d99

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5c005e0e42e207b073843b255248877b84442342
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5c005e0e42e207b073843b255248877b84442342` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `a9a6589d427ab6f71b0d06f0a1fe0f1dd4764276`
Local-runs: none
Regen-provenance: 7f41ed5f — changeset-only 042bdb52 and docs-only 7f41ed5f on a9a6589d (prose faces)

### ① Derived judgments

- `create_upload_link` with `objectName` + `field` and no `recordId` (`mcp-http-tools.ts#registerFileTools`, `record-file-access.ts#createUploadLinkForNewRecordAs`): **right**. This is ruling A's "link before the record exists, naming the table and field". `recordId` is optional only where the bridge serves the member, and a bridge without it keeps the old schema.
- `fileIds: [link.id]` in the answer: **right**. The agent creates the record naming the file id, as ruling A says. The array shape leaves #32747 additive: N files need N reserved rows and N ids under the same key, and nothing here forecloses that.
- A bound file id accepted in a required file field on create and update (`file-reference-lifecycle.ts#applyCopyOnClaim` → `pre-record-upload.ts#preRecordReferenceRefusal`): **right**. `required` is untouched. The file is a committed row before the create names it, and the create still runs under the user's permissions and validations. The update path is in the card's option A (`create_record` / `update_record`).
- New refusals (mint: system context `PERMISSION_DENIED`, create verdict `PERMISSION_DENIED`, writability and `readonly` `FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, non-file or missing field `VALIDATION_ERROR`; upload: `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` before spend; write: `VALIDATION_FAILED`/`invalid_value` for not_yours / other_slot / spent / expired; MCP: attachments with no record): **right**. They fall only on the new class. Ruling B of #30892 holds: `requireUserContext` admits a signed-in user only, the link is single-use and lasts 10 minutes for one user, and the binding is for one user and expires after 1 hour.
- Narrowed download for bound files (`storage-service-plugin.ts#judgeFileRead`, `isUploaderOnlyFile` after the owner arm): **right** while no record has held the file. It is **wrong after a release**; see ③ F1.

### ② Semver level

- At `a9a6589d` the changeset graded `service-storage`, `mcp` and `runtime` as `minor` under `Metadata-protocol: none`. That is wrong under ruling A on #25105 (`none` means patch), and `Check Changeset` failed. At `042bdb52` all three are `patch` and the changeset reads `Clause-②: yes (widening)` / `Metadata-protocol: none`. **Right**: `Check Changeset` succeeded on `042bdb52`, and its run on `7f41ed5f` is in progress.
- `Clause-②: yes`: **right**. The diff widens a published accept set (a new MCP call shape, a new file id class accepted on writes) and narrows nothing an existing call reaches.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: **right**. No `packages/spec` file is touched and no authorable key changes. The binding rides the `sys_file.metadata` data column. The changed TS types (`McpFileBridge`, `McpRecordFileService`) gain only optional members, and `ICallerRecordFileService` / `UploadLinkOutcome` are not exported from `service-storage`'s index. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private.
- The changeset prose agrees with the code, except for the "with a reason" wording (F4).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Mint permission.** `createUploadLinkForNewRecordAs` asks `security.explain({object, operation:'create'}, caller)`, which uses the enforcement path's own resolution and is the verdict REST's create door asks (`rest-server.ts`). It also asks `getWritableFields` and the field's `readonly`. That is stricter than the console, whose `presign` needs only a session, and the create is still judged in full afterwards. A user without create permission gets no link and no reserved row; the dogfood pin asserts `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` and an unchanged pending count. With no security service, no create is permission-gated either.
- **User B and A's id.** For a create or update, `findReferenceableFile` calls `judgeFileRead`, which denies (`'refused'`), and `not_yours` also refuses even without `authorizeRead`. Both doors, `/files/:id/url` and `/files/:id`, go through `authorizeDownload` → `judgeFileRead` and deny. A system or context-less write (`referencingCallerOf` gives null for `isSystem`) gets `not_yours` while the file is unheld. Another object or field gets `other_slot`, and a second record within the hour gets `spent`. The 1-hour window is checked at the write (`Date.now()` against `claim_until`). `accept`/`maxSize` are checked by `assertFileConstraints` before `updateFileIfUnchanged` spends the link, and the link is left unspent on refusal.
- **Unbound behaviour.** It is unchanged. `preRecordBindingOf` returns null without the `pre_record_upload` kind. `isPreRecordLinkRow` excludes every link row that carries a `record_id`. `openLinkStateOf` still refuses an attachments link without a record and an empty `record_id`. `consumeUploadLink`'s record-link branch only gains a `recordId` parameter. The console-style control pin (presign, PUT, complete, save, no binding) covers this.
- **F1 · should-fix · the binding outlives the claim.** `claimFile` never clears `sys_file.metadata`, and `releaseOwnership` clears only `ref_*`. Once the holding record lets the file go (the field is cleared or replaced, or the record is deleted), the row is unheld and bound again. Three things follow:
  - (a) `judgeFileRead` returns `deny` via `isUploaderOnlyFile` before the #26046 released-record arm, so the releasing record's readers lose the file.
  - (b) Within the hour, the uploader can clear record 1 and put the file in record 2, which bypasses the one-record rule.
  - (c) After the hour, every write is refused (`expired` / `not_yours`), including the uploader's restore and system writes, where #26046 re-claims.

  This contradicts the PR body, `pre-record-upload.ts`'s header and row 47f ("once a record holds it, it is that record's file like any other"). The fix: retire the binding at first claim, or ignore it when `released_ref_*` is set, and add a pin.
- **F2 · should-fix · orphan reclamation.** A bound file that is uploaded and never claimed stays a committed row forever. The lifecycle reaps only `deleted_at` (30 days) and `pending` (7 days), the same gap as a console upload that is never saved. After the hour no write can use the file, but its bytes stay. The PR body and the `record-file-access.ts` module comment state this honestly, and `verify-file-references` reports the file as `unreferenced_file`. The out-of-scope finding is not yet a card (no hit in the search), and the ruling made reclamation part of this review: file the card before landing. The binding (unheld, `claim_until` past) gives a reaper an exact predicate.
- **F3 · nit · the reserved row before upload.** `fileIds[0]` is published at mint and is the `pending` link row. A system or context-less write naming it passes, because `preRecordReferenceRefusal` sees no binding and the incomplete-upload check is guarded by `caller &&`. It claims the row, and the later upload lands into that record. This posture already exists for every pending row (row 47f), but only this class publishes the id. Treating `isPreRecordLinkRow` as bound in `preRecordReferenceRefusal` closes it.
- **F4 · nit · docs and prose wording.** The `connect-mcp.mdx` paragraph and the changeset say every refusal comes "with the reason". Another user's write and a system write get the unreadable-file words, by design. "Refused after the hour" and "in one record" hold only while no record holds the file, and after the hour copy-on-claim applies. Row 47e's shared sentence ("read the record … as that user") does not describe the new verb, which reads no record and asks the create verdict. The `plugin-endpoints.mdx` PUT sentence at `7f41ed5f` is true (stored under the answered id for that field); it says "the user's create" where update also works.
- **Row 47f edit:** **true** for an uploaded, unheld bound file (system write → `not_yours` → field refusal), and needed. Without it, "a system write claims … any file" would be false. "Until a record holds it" is imprecise given F1. It goes beyond the amendment's named row (47e only); the dev disclosed this, and the claim record should name 47f.
- **F5 · nit · error envelopes.** The storage refusals carry ADR-0112/0114 `code` + `status`, and the tests assert both (`refusedAt`, the minting `toMatchObject`, `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT`, MCP `PERMISSION_DENIED`/403). Two pins are weaker. The bound-file download refusal is pinned on status only: 403 in the integration test and `not.toBe(200)` in dogfood, with no `FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED`. The two MCP-local argument refusals carry no code, matching the tool's existing pre-bridge refusals.
- **Negative pins.** Reading the code: the other-user write is guarded twice (the read check, then `not_yours`), so ablations 2 and 3 going green is correct, and each arm fails alone (ablation 4 unit, ablation 9 downloads). The system-write, slot, spent, expiry, create-verdict, writability, `readonly`, accept/maxSize, MCP schema and bridge-member pins each have a single guard and go red when it is removed. The release case of F1 has no pin.
- **Gates (check-runs as read).** `a9a6589d` was superseded. `Check Changeset` failed there (minor under `Metadata-protocol: none`), 21 lanes were cancelled, and the `Lint & Repo Gates` / `TypeScript Type Check` aggregates failed only because their lanes were cancelled. `042bdb52` (also superseded): `Check Changeset` success, 16 success, 20 cancelled, and the same 2 aggregates failed because their lanes were cancelled. `7f41ed5f` (the current head): 6 success, 15 skipped, 15 in progress (including `Check Changeset`, every Lint and Type Check lane), 6 queued (Build Core, Build Docs, Dogfood Regression Gate, Live E2E UI, Plan Test Core shards, Test UI). No code gate has a verdict on the current head yet, so the merge still waits on them.
- **F6 · nit.** The PR body's `Clause-②:` line carries no `(widening)` arm, while the changeset at `042bdb52` does, and `Check Changeset` reads "direction arm: none declared". This is harmless because only a narrowing arm is consumed, but the two should match.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vlkibi`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzuZJBQY4wUQFJbkfx`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2aaea77af4ce68f15c26c1643eeb3330f9629d99`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- **Delta review of record 6857928485** (head `a9a6589d`, verdict PASS, prose faces `042bdb52`/`7f41ed5f`). Scope: `git diff 7f41ed5f 2aaea77a`, one commit, 10 files. The code moved in `pre-record-upload.ts` only, with comments in `file-reference-lifecycle.ts` and `record-file-access.ts`. The tests moved in `pre-record-upload.test.ts`, `record-file-access.integration.test.ts` and the dogfood file. The prose moved in the changeset, `connect-mcp.mdx`, `plugin-endpoints.mdx` and `system-context.mdx` rows 47e/47f. Every judgment in 6857928485 that this delta does not touch stands.
- `preRecordReferenceRefusal`, with `heldHere` moved to the top: **right**. The answer is identical for every input; it was `!binding || heldHere` → null before.
- A binding is ignored once `released_ref_*` is set (`released`, `neverHeld`): **right**. A file a record has held and let go is judged by #26046 as any released file. `claimFile` clears `released_ref_*` when a second record takes the file, so while that record holds it the held-file rule applies again (`spent` / `not_yours` within the hour).
- The pending link row (`isPreRecordLinkRow && neverHeld`) refuses a system or context-less writer and any writer other than `owner_id` with `not_yours`: **right**. Each of them gets the unreadable-file words. The uploader still falls to the incomplete-upload check, and record-link rows are untouched (`record_id` present → null, pinned).
- The new question, whether the uploader can now put a released file into a second record within the hour: **yes, and consistent with ruling A**. The sequence is R1 takes it, R1 clears the field, R2 takes it. The file is in at most one record at any time: `spent` still refuses a second record while the first holds it. The move is #26046's re-claim of a released file, which every released file allows its releasing record's readers. The same holds for a reader of R1 re-claiming it, and for other fields or objects after the release. Ruling A's constraints are a pre-record link for one signed-in user that expires; they govern the window before any record held the file, and once a record holds it, it is that record's file. The rework states this in the changeset, `connect-mcp.mdx` and row 47f. #32747 stays additive: no key or shape changed.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset is unchanged in level: `patch` for `service-storage`, `mcp` and `runtime`, with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. **Right**. The delta narrows only the new class and adds no published key. `Check Changeset` succeeded on `2aaea77a`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **F1 (was should-fix): resolved.**
  - `isUploaderOnlyFile` now requires `neverHeld`, so `judgeFileRead` reaches the #26046 released arm, and `preRecordReferenceRefusal` answers null for an unheld released row.
  - The integration pin covers the whole sequence: R1 takes the file, R1 releases it, the reviewer downloads with 200, and R2 takes it past the window. It goes red if either guard is removed: the download returns 403 without `neverHeld`, and the take is refused as `expired` without the released arm.
  - The unit pins cover each arm on its own.
- **F2 (was should-fix): resolved outside the diff.** #33125 is open: "a committed upload that no record ever names is never reclaimed (new path: MCP pre-record upload links)".
- **F3 (was nit): resolved.** The integration pin shows a system write and another user refused before the upload, the row still `pending` and unclaimed, and the upload and the uploader's create still taken. Removing the new arm makes the system insert succeed, so the pin goes red.
- **F4 (was nit): resolved, with one residue (nit).**
  - These now match the code: the changeset paragraph, the `connect-mcp.mdx` paragraph, row 47e (the new verb asks the create verdict and the field's writability), row 47f (the pre-upload id, a system write copying a held file, a released file judged as any) and the `plugin-endpoints.mdx` PUT row ("create or update").
  - Residue: `connect-mcp.mdx` says "Within the hour, a second record naming it while the first holds it is refused too". That is unqualified, but a system write copies a held file (`writerUserId === null` → null). The sentence is true for every MCP or user write, which is the page's audience, and row 47f states the system case.
- **F5 (was nit): resolved.** The integration pin asserts `error.code: 'FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED'` beside the 403. The dogfood pin now asserts `403` and `FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED` in place of `not.toBe(200)`.
- **F6 (was nit): open.** The PR body's `Clause-②:` line still has no `(widening)` arm, while the changeset has one. It is harmless because only a narrowing arm is consumed, but the two should match. Also still open: the 47f edit is not named in the claim amendments 6856718179 and 6857811650.
- **Unbound behaviour after the rework:** unchanged. `neverHeld` only shrinks the uploader-only set. The pending-row arm fires only on a no-record link row, and `heldHere` is semantics-preserving. Nothing changed outside `pre-record-upload.ts`'s two predicates. I found no new hole: a released bound file gets exactly the reach of any released file, and an unheld, never-held bound file keeps every refusal it had.
- **Gates (check-runs on `2aaea77a`, as read):** 13 success (including `Check Changeset`), 15 skipped, and 14 in progress (Build Core, Build Docs, Live E2E UI, Plan Test Core shards, every Lint lane, every Type Check lane). No failure, and Test Core has not started. The code gates have no verdict on this head yet, so the merge waits on them.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vlkibi`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzuZJBQY4wUQFJbkfx`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 · PR #33123 @ `2aaea77a` · 2026-11-13T16:58Z

- 改了什么：上传链接可以只指定对象和文件字段、不指定记录。用户上传后，智能体用返回的 `fileIds[0]` 调 `create_record`（或 `update_record`），就能建出带必填文件字段的记录，例如报销明细加必填电子发票，只需两次智能体调用加一次浏览器上传。`required` 规则不变。
- 为什么改：以前链接必须先有记录，记录又必须先有文件，智能体因此建不出这类记录（你的裁决 A，6844207600）。
- 权限与边界：签发链接时，要求该用户能创建该对象、能写该字段、字段不是只读。链接仍是登录用户、单人、10 分钟过期、一次性（#30892 裁决 B）。上传的文件在还没有被任何记录占用前，只能由上传者在一小时内放进该对象该字段的一条记录，也只有上传者能下载。别人的写入、系统写入、别的字段、第二条记录、超时，都在字段上被拒。被记录占用并释放之后，它就是一份普通文件。
- 风险与回滚：这是一处放宽，只新增了调用形态。已有调用和已有文件的判法不变，回滚就是 revert。上传后一直没被引用的文件目前不会回收，与控制台上传后放弃保存是同一类问题，已立卡 #33125。
- 先看：`pre-record-upload.ts`（绑定与判定）；`record-file-access.ts` 的 `createUploadLinkForNewRecordAs`；验收在 `showcase-mcp-record-files.dogfood.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：落地。两轮契约复审，首轮的应修项（绑定比占用活得久）已修好，增量复审 PASS；CI 全绿；没有碰受管面，改动 1448 行。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** draft → `main`，正文第 4 行 `Fixes #32686`，合并后应当关卡，正文其余地方没有挨着别的 open 卡号的闭合关键词。`Clause-②: yes (widening)`、`Metadata-protocol: none`，`Skills-docs: updated here`（served `skill-md.ts`、`connect-mcp.mdx`、`system-context.mdx` 47e/47f、`plugin-endpoints.mdx` 的 PUT 行，四页的句子都对照代码核过，见复审记录 ③）。changeset `32686-upload-before-record.md` 三个包都是 `patch`（Metadata-protocol none 的等级轴；`minor` 已在 `042bdb52` 改正）。没有改 `content/docs/releases/`。文件面 = 认领 6855856900 加修订 6856718179、6857811650 与 47f 那一行的修订。
- **前提实测:** 卡上三个读数，dev 在 `origin/main` `2c98485d` 上重新测过（报告 6857711797）；派发前的形状提案 `out/32686-proposed-shape.md` 由席位对照裁决 A 核过。
- **门禁 check-runs @ `2aaea77a`:** 57 个，40 success、17 skipped、0 失败（Lint & Repo Gates、TypeScript Type Check、Test Core 1–8/8、Dogfood Regression Gate、Check Changeset 都是 success）。本地：service-storage 82/82 文件，dogfood 18/18，101 个派生门禁加 3 个 roster 门禁 exit 0（`--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED），返工后 11 条消融全部转红并已恢复。
- **契约复审:** 首轮 6857928485 在 `a9a6589d` 上 PASS（`TIER_DEFAULT`，declaration 面；`042bdb52`/`7f41ed5f` 只动 changeset 与文档，记了 `Regen-provenance`），应修 F1、F2，nit F3–F6。增量复审 6858877271 在 `2aaea77a` 上 PASS：F1、F3、F4、F5 已修，F2 立卡 #33125，F6 由席位改了 PR 正文的 Clause-② 行。
